title: Client Report Rejection
lessonTitle: Transitioning from Individual Contributor to Manager

checklistItems.label: Kept Sam open after the client flag (listen / respond; not push into defense or shutdown)
Agreed next report actions and timing
Kept ownership with Sam; did not take over the report
Named the client flag; agreed how progress is checked before resubmit

scenarioSummary.now: First 1:1 after the client flagged a report with numbers Sam owned.
scenarioSummary.layers: Trust → goals this week → who reworks the numbers → check before the client sees it again → close.
